fact: Gavi's VaccinesWork reported on 29 August 2024 that Djibouti faces the failings of medical follow-up kept on paper and the loss of information along a paper care pathway, quoting the founder of the e-health company Medyc that in digital health 'à Djibouti, tout est à faire'; it names no electronic patient record in any public facility and does not say the paper position holds at every tier.
title: Doucement mais sûrement, la santé devient numérique à Djibouti
